original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. No armada-poc script references the removed ArmadaToken addToWhitelist function or the removed wind-down code. E6 (arp-6bc) deleted both from contracts/governance/ArmadaToken.sol. A grep of scripts/check-armada-token-invariants.py finds no addToWhitelist text and no windDownContract text. A grep of scripts/deploy_revenue_lock_cohort.ts finds no addToWhitelist text. The check-armada-token-invariants.py module still imports without error and its remaining mutations still apply. Contracts stay unchanged; this touches scripts only.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. Three sites keep dead references. scripts/check-armada-token-invariants.py keeps _mutation_open_add_to_whitelist (lines 105-116) and its open-add-to-whitelist MUTATIONS entry (line 166), and _mutation_require_wind_down_contract (lines 149-160) and its require-wind-down-contract entry (line 169). Both anchor on source text that no longer exists, so each raises AssertionError if invoked. scripts/deploy_revenue_lock_cohort.ts line 221 prints an armToken.addToWhitelist next-step instruction that reverts. The allowlist is now fixed at deploy via initWhitelist.
restatement: The scripts in armada-poc must stop referring to the ArmadaToken addToWhitelist function and the wind-down code, which E6 (arp-6bc) removed from contracts/governance/ArmadaToken.sol. The invariant checker scripts/check-armada-token-invariants.py must lose its two dead mutations: the open-add-to-whitelist one and the require-wind-down-contract one. Each helper function and each MUTATIONS entry goes. The deploy script scripts/deploy_revenue_lock_cohort.ts must stop printing the next-step instruction that calls armToken.addToWhitelist, because that call reverts. The allowlist is now fixed at deploy through initWhitelist. After the cleanup, the checker module must still import without error and its remaining mutations must still apply. No contract file changes. Only scripts change.

A grep of scripts/deploy_revenue_lock_cohort.ts finds no addToWhitelist text. The reverting armToken.addToWhitelist next-step instruction is no longer printed.
